newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq edges lower on late round of tech sales.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq edges lower on late round of tech sales.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks finished slightly lower as early gains were erased by an afternoon bout of selling.

The Nasdaq Composite Index fell one point to 1227 after holding to a fairly tight range all session. The index touched as high as 1236 in early afternoon activity but eventually succumbed to a sell-off in network technology shares.
"It seemed as though sellers had been patient all day and then decided they had to get something done," said one trader. "We didn't really see any big names doing any major selling."

Cable television company Tele-Communications Inc was Nasdaq's busiest stock, falling 1/2 to 11-5/8. The company said it was comfortable with estimates putting third quarter cash flow at $575 million to $630 million but also said it lost customers during July and August and has told major vendors to hold equipment shipments until further notice.
Among the other most heavily traded Nasdaq shares were technology companies Cisco Systems Inc, which dropped 2-7/8 to 60, 3Com Corp, off 1-3/8 to 62-7/8 and Intel Corp, down 1-7/8 to 107-1/2.
Declining issues barely outnumbered advancers by 1559 to 1526 with 835 issues unchanged on the day.
